name: Pagination
description: Page navigation with previous, next and numbered buttons, plus a dialog for jumping to any page.

page.description: Controlled current page, from 1; a page past the last one shows the last page.

defaultPage.description: Uncontrolled page on mount, from 1; read once.

total.description: Number of items being paged, an integer from 0; no items still show page 1.

pageSize.description: Items per page, an integer from 1.

siblingCount.description: Page buttons on each side of the current page, an integer from 0 to 20; the bar keeps its length near either end.

disabled.description: Disables page changes and the picker button; an open picker can still be closed.

membrane.description: Membrane spacing around the navigation buttons; the picker dialog owns its own spacing.

labels.description: Names and text of the component's own controls; the nav itself takes a native aria-label or aria-labelledby.

behavior.navigation: Previous/Next and numbered Button controls share one bounded page projection. Re-selecting the visible page is a no-op. External page/total/pageSize updates are quiet.
behavior.picker: A Modal with a native number input supports direct page jumps without allocating the entire page range. Narrow containers place numbered controls on a separate row.
behavior.disabled: Disables page changes and picker opening. An already open picker remains closable.
behavior.localization: labels translates the component's own controls; labels.choosePage names the picker button and titles its dialog. Native aria-label/aria-labelledby names the nav.

aria.label: Native aria-label or aria-labelledby names the nav; default aria-label is Pagination.
aria.current: The current numbered button exposes aria-current=page.
aria.controls: All page actions use native buttons; the picker has a labelled spinbutton with min/max, range description and invalid state.

notes: Navigation buttons use shared Button variants and Membrane. Pagination owns layout and label wrapping.
The page picker inherits shared Modal and Input tokens.

whenNotToUse: Few items that fit on one page
